summary.zh: 本次更新完善了发布流程：版本摘要生成已迁移至 DeepSeek，并修复了摘要中混入模型推理文本的问题；同时对 0.1.23 的发布产物激活进行了修复和加固。
summary.en: This release improves the release workflow: digest generation now uses DeepSeek, and a fix prevents model reasoning text from leaking into the digest; it also repairs and hardens 0.1.23 artifact activation.

summary.zh: 应用内更新说明的生成流程已迁移到 DeepSeek 模型。
summary.en: The in-app release digest generation has been migrated to the DeepSeek model.

details.zh: 版本摘要现在由 DeepSeek 模型生成，以替代原有流程。
details.en: Release digests are now generated by the DeepSeek model, replacing the previous flow.

sources.title: release: migrate digest generation to DeepSeek

title.zh: 过滤 DeepSeek 推理文本

summary.zh: 修复了生成摘要时可能混入模型推理文本的问题，只保留最终摘要内容。
summary.en: Fixed an issue where model reasoning text could leak into the digest, so only the final summary is shown.

details.zh: DeepSeek 的思考过程不再出现在更新说明中。
details.en: DeepSeek's reasoning process no longer appears in the update notes.

summary.zh: 修复了发布产物的激活流程，并加固了 0.1.23 的发布稳定性。
summary.en: Fixed the release artifact activation flow and hardened 0.1.23 for more reliable releases.

details.zh: 发布产物激活已修复，避免新版本无法正常使用。
details.en: Release artifact activation has been repaired to prevent issues with the new version.

details.zh: 对 0.1.23 进行额外加固，提升发布可靠性。
details.en: Additional hardening for 0.1.23 improves release reliability.

sources.title: release: repair artifact activation and harden 0.1.23
